name: DescribeContainerGroupStatus

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string
parameters.help_zh: ECI实例ID序列。最多20个，字符串需按照JSON格式传入
parameters.name: container_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The time in seconds. The operation returns the status of ECI instances that were updated within this time period. This parameter is used for polling
parameters.help_zh: 返回最近几秒内有状态更新的ECI实例状态，用于轮询查询状态
parameters.name: since_second

parameters.help_en: The tags attached to the ECI instance
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. You can get the token from the `NextToken` parameter in the response to the previous request
parameters.help_zh:
下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。    
首次查询时无需设置该参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of ECI instances to return. The default value is 200.

The number of instances returned is less than or equal to the specified value
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回资源（ECI实例）的数量。默认为200个。

返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit
